name: Paper_Reading_Benchmark
description: A reading-comprehension style benchmark that tests model ability to read, understand, and answer questions about academic papers. It contains question–answer pairs (or prompts) derived from research papers to evaluate factual extraction, reasoning about methods/results, and summarization of paper content.
reputation: Hosted on Hugging Face with limited community usage so far; useful for research-paper comprehension evaluation but not yet widely adopted.
